title: Nab-paclitaxel Combined With S-1 Treating Diffuse Type of Stage Ⅲ Gastric Cancer
brief_summary: Investigators assessed the effectiveness of Nab-paclitaxel combined with S-1 treating diffuse type of stage Ⅲ gastric cancer as adjuvant setting
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* gastric cancer patients after radical resection
* diffuse type gastric cancer stage III

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who have metastasis disease
* Patients who can not tolerate chemotherapy
